en: Romans 6

p.src: 1  What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

ja: にとどまるべきでしょうか。
en: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
u.src: 1  What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

p.src: 2  May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

ja: してそうではありません。
たちが、どうしてなおも
en: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
u.src: 2  May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

p.src: 3  Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

ja: それとも、キリスト・イエスへのバプテスマを
en: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
u.src: 3  Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

p.src: 4  We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

ja: たちは死へのバプテスマによって、キリストと
られました。それは、キリストが御
からよみがえらされたように、
en: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
u.src: 4  We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

p.src: 5  For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

ja: になって、この方と一つにされたのなら、その
en: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
u.src: 5  For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

p.src: 6  knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

ja: につけられました。それは、
en: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
u.src: 6  knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

p.src: 7  For he who has died has been freed from sin.

en: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
u.src: 7  For he who has died has been freed from sin.

p.src: 8  But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

ja: んだのなら、キリストと
en: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
u.src: 8  But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

p.src: 9  knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

ja: からよみがえらされたキリストが、もはや
ぬことはないと知っています。
en: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
u.src: 9  knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

p.src: 10  For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

en: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
u.src: 10  For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

p.src: 11  Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ja: じようにあなたがたも、
キリスト・イエスにあって神に対して
en: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
u.src: 11  Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

p.src: 12  Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

en: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
u.src: 12  Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

p.src: 13  Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

ja: してはなりません。むしろ、
en: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
u.src: 13  Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

p.src: 14  For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

ja: することはありません。あなたがたは
みのもとにいるからです。
en: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
u.src: 14  For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

p.src: 15  What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

ja: みのもとにいるのだから、
してもよいのでしょうか。
してそうではありません。
en: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
u.src: 15  What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

p.src: 16  Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

ja: 自身をしもべとしてだれかに
うなら、あなたがたはその
en: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
u.src: 16  Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

p.src: 17  But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

ja: します。あなたがたはかつて
でしたが、あなたがたに
en: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
u.src: 17  But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

p.src: 18  Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

ja: のしもべとなりました。
en: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
u.src: 18  Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

p.src: 19  I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

ja: に陥っていました。それと
じように今は、体の各部
en: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
u.src: 19  I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

p.src: 20  For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

en: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
u.src: 20  For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

p.src: 21  What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

ja: たのでしょう。それらの行き着く先は
en: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
u.src: 21  What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

p.src: 22  But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

ja: のしもべとなったあなたがたは、その実として聖なる者とされ、その行き着く先に
en: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
u.src: 22  But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

p.src: 23  For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ja: キリスト・イエスにある
en: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
u.src: 23  For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
